title: Dental PPO Plans Coinsurance by Network on Reprocessed Initial-Wait Lines
content:
Schedule note, Dental PPO Plans. The coinsurance a line reprocessed after a denial for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date (a reprocessed initial-wait line) is figured at follows the line's network status, and so decides the patient share on such a line:
- a basic-class line from an out-of-network practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network basic percentage;
- a major-class line from an out-of-network practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network major percentage;
- any other line is figured at the plan's in-network percentage for its service class.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Out-of-network basic (percent) | 0 | 60 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 |
| Out-of-network major (percent) | 0 | 0 | 40 | 50 | 50 | 60 |
| In-network preventive (percent) | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| In-network basic (percent) | 0 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 | 90 |
| In-network major (percent) | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 60 | 60 |

"Any other line" covers every in-network line (PPO or Premier in-network) and a preventive-class line from an out-of-network practice; such a preventive line is figured at the in-network preventive percentage.

### Examples (hypothetical lines on Classic 1250)
| Line | Percentage |
|---|---|
| Major class, out-of-network practice | 40 |
| Major class, in-network practice | 50 |
| Preventive class, out-of-network practice | 100 |
